en: Black‑and‑white view of an old European market square bordered by ornate, multi‑story townhouses with arcades at street level. There is a small tower with a cupola on one of the buildings. Horse‑drawn carts and a few pedestrians are visible on a cobblestone square. Shop signs are visible on the facades, and a caption is printed along the bottom edge of the image.
